subject: general
question: What is the full form of UNEP.
solution:
the correct answer is **United Nations Environment Programme.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Coordination of environmental responses across **the United Nations system** is the responsibility of the **United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP).**
 
• Maurice Strong, its first director, created it following the **United Nations Conference** on the** Human Environment in Stockholm in June 1972.**
 
• Its goal is to give leadership, produce science, and develop solutions to a wide variety of issues, including climate change, the management of marine and terrestrial ecosystems, and green economic growth.
 
• The group also creates **worldwide environmental treaties, disseminates environmental knowledge, and aids national governments in achieving environmental goals.**
